an10.77:1.3: dhaṃsī ca pagabbho ca tintino ca mahagghaso ca luddo ca akāruṇiko ca dubbalo ca oravitā ca muṭṭhassatī ca necayikoca.
an10.77:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato kāko.
an10.77:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu.
an10.77:1.7: dhaṃsī ca pagabbho ca tintino ca mahagghaso ca luddo ca akāruṇiko ca dubbalo ca oravitā ca muṭṭhassatī ca necayiko ca.
